topic: Why RAG retrieval failures are the real bottleneck in production
details: We spend too much time tuning prompts and model parameters. In reality, the quality of chunking, hybrid search, and metadata filtering determines 90% of RAG success. Share lessons from building production pipelines.

topic: The hidden cost of state machine management in Agentic AI
details: Building agents is easy, but managing state, human-in-the-loop, and error recovery is where projects stall. Discuss the complexity of workflow frameworks like LangGraph and how to handle agent loops in real applications.

topic: AI Voice Bots vs. Touchtone IVR: The developer perspective
details: Most legacy voice systems fail because of high latency and bad speech-to-text. Let's talk about the latency budget for real-time voice conversations (e.g. Deepgram + LLM + TTS under 800ms) and how we optimize it.
